changeSet.author: nexus-hczdo.1.1
changeSet.comment: nexus.identity_counters and nexus.identity_records (RDR-253): the per-tenant id counter and the identity record with its current generation, state and holder. Tenant-scoped, RLS ENABLE+FORCE with memory-001-3's tenant_isolation policy shape.
changeSet.rollback: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS nexus.identity_records CASCADE; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS nexus.identity_counters CASCADE;

changeSet.author: nexus-hczdo.1.1
changeSet.comment: nexus.identity_aliases (RDR-253): every name ever given to a seat, live or retired. The name is the primary key within a tenant, so a retired name is never reissued; one live alias per identity. Tenant-scoped, RLS ENABLE+FORCE.
changeSet.rollback: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS nexus.identity_aliases CASCADE

changeSet.author: nexus-hczdo.1.1
changeSet.comment: nexus.identity_bindings (the append-only binding log) and nexus.identity_sessions (the session index) (RDR-253). Both reference identity_records ON DELETE CASCADE, so a tombstone removes them with the identity. Tenant-scoped, RLS ENABLE+FORCE.
changeSet.rollback: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS nexus.identity_sessions CASCADE; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS nexus.identity_bindings CASCADE;

changeSet.author: nexus-hczdo.1.1
changeSet.comment: nexus.identity_memberships (RDR-253): the group memberships of an identity, permanent until the identity leaves the group or is tombstoned. References identity_records ON DELETE CASCADE. Tenant-scoped, RLS ENABLE+FORCE.
changeSet.rollback: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS nexus.identity_memberships CASCADE
